name: Honda Nighthawk 650 / 700S
engine: 655 or 696 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs, shaft drive, hydraulic lifters
intro: Early-80s Nighthawk fours with shaft drive and self-adjusting valves. The charging system is the usual weak spot.

add.title: Test the charging system
add.instructions: Check battery voltage at idle and at 5,000 rpm. Below about 13 V at speed points at the regulator/rectifier or stator.
add.reason: Regulator/rectifier failure is a common Nighthawk problem.

H: The valves use hydraulic lifters. Change the oil on time, because old oil makes them tick.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Regulator/rectifier
known.what: Regulator/rectifier failure kills the charging system and leaves a flat battery.
